name: Boredom-Busting Bubblegum
effect: Revives the selected character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1,500 HP.
description: Lohen's specialty. Seeing that you were bored, he handed you a few candies and grandly claimed they'd help pass the time. After only a few chews, he suddenly pulled out a mirror and flashed it in front of you, looking entirely too pleased with himself. Oh no — it was a setup all along! Your tongue was already dyed a bright blue-green... So by "help pass the time," he meant his own?
